title: Case 252: Margaret Maher, Mersina Halvagis & Nicole Patterson

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The names of several witnesses in this case have been changed.
sentences.zh: 本案中几位证人的姓名已作更改。

sentences.en: Melbourne resident Irene Langley was looking through the Herald Sun newspaper when she came across a job ad for phone sex workers.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本居民艾琳·兰利在翻阅《先驱太阳报》时，偶然看到了一则电话性工作者的招聘广告。

sentences.en: The customer would ring a 1-900 number and hear pre-recorded messages from various women.
sentences.zh: 客户拨打一个1-900开头的号码，就能听到不同女性预先录制好的语音信息。

sentences.en: When they heard one they liked, they'd dial a PIN number that directed the call to that particular person.
sentences.zh: 当他们听到心仪的声音时，会拨打一个个人识别码（PIN），将电话转接到该特定人员。

sentences.en: Irene took on the job and had the calls come through to her home phone.
sentences.zh: 艾琳接下了这份工作，并将电话转接到家里的座机上。

sentences.en: After a year in the role, only three calls left her feeling disturbed.
sentences.zh: 在从事该职位的这一年里，只有三通电话让她感到不安。

sentences.en: One customer told Irene that he'd become sexually aroused while watching his sister shower.
sentences.zh: 一位客户告诉艾琳，他在看妹妹洗澡时产生了性冲动。

sentences.en: Another expressed a desire to have sex with his own daughter.
sentences.zh: 另一位则表达了想与自己女儿发生性关系的欲望。

sentences.en: The third man wanted to speak to an older woman.
sentences.zh: 第三名男子想找一位年长的女性聊天。

sentences.en: To appease him, Irene pretended she was 55 years old.
sentences.zh: 为了安抚他，艾琳谎称自己55岁。

sentences.en: In a mean, angry voice, the caller asked,
sentences.zh: 电话那头，男子用一种刻薄、愤怒的声音问道：

sentences.en: Do you know what I did to the bitch?
sentences.zh: “你知道我对那个婊子做了什么吗？”

sentences.en: When Irene asked who, the man responded,
sentences.zh: 当艾琳问是谁时，男子回答道：

sentences.en: My mother, the bitch.
sentences.zh: “我妈，那个婊子。”

sentences.en: He said he'd pressed his hand on her neck before cutting across one of her breasts and slicing through her nipple.
sentences.zh: 他说他用手按住她的脖子，然后割开了她的一侧乳房，切断了她的乳头。

sentences.en: As the man spoke of the blood, his voice became animated and his breathing increased, as though he were aroused.
sentences.zh: 当男子谈论血液时，他的声音变得兴奋起来，呼吸也随之急促，仿佛正处于性兴奋中。

sentences.en: How does that make you feel?
sentences.zh: “这让你感觉如何？”

sentences.en: He asked.
sentences.zh: 他问道。

sentences.en: Horrified, Irene ended the call.
sentences.zh: 艾琳感到恐惧，挂断了电话。

sentences.en: The man called back shortly after, warning,
sentences.zh: 不久后，那名男子又打了回来，警告道：

sentences.en: Listen, don't hang up.
sentences.zh: “听着，别挂电话。”

sentences.en: I know where you live and who you are.
sentences.zh: “我知道你住哪儿，也知道你是谁。”

sentences.en: Again, he started talking about attacking a woman, his tone low and hateful.
sentences.zh: 他又开始谈论袭击一名女性，语气低沉而充满仇恨。

sentences.en: Irene listened in stunned fear, struggling to take in what the caller was saying.
sentences.zh: 艾琳惊恐万分地听着，努力消化着对方所说的话。

sentences.en: He said he looked into the woman's eyes as he put the steel down her stomach.
sentences.zh: 他说当他把钢刀刺入那女人的腹部时，他直视着她的眼睛。

sentences.en: He didn't say knife specifically, but Irene knew that's what he meant.
sentences.zh: 他没有明确说出“刀”这个词，但艾琳知道他指的就是那个。

sentences.en: She tried to interrupt, but it only made the man angry.
sentences.zh: 她试图打断他，但这只会让那名男子更加愤怒。

sentences.en: He mentioned the blood again, how it had seeped out of the cut nipple and gotten on him.
sentences.zh: 他又提到了血，说血从被割开的乳头渗出来，溅到了他身上。

sentences.en: He then spoke of, quote,
sentences.zh: 随后他说了这样一句话，引用如下：

sentences.en: Fucking the woman with the blade.
sentences.zh: “用刀刃操那个女人。”

sentences.en: Irene could hear his excitement growing and believed he was now masturbating.
sentences.zh: 艾琳能听到他的兴奋感在不断增强，并相信他当时正在自慰。

sentences.en: His description of the mutilation was so vivid, Irene could picture the woman as a real person.
sentences.zh: 他对肢解过程的描述如此生动，以至于艾琳仿佛能想象出那个女人是一个活生生的人。

sentences.en: She called him a sick prick and hung up.
sentences.zh: 她骂他是个变态混蛋，然后挂断了电话。

sentences.en: Irene waited, then picked up the receiver again.
sentences.zh: 艾琳等了一会儿，又拿起了听筒。

sentences.en: The man was still there.
sentences.zh: 那名男子还在线上。

sentences.en: Old cunt, he barked, before Irene swiftly pulled the phone's cord from the wall.
sentences.zh: “老婊子。”他咆哮道，随后艾琳迅速拔掉了墙上的电话线。

sentences.en: It was a little after 1pm on Saturday, October 4, 1997, when pensioners Ronald and Muriel MacDonald drove down Clifford's Road.
sentences.zh: 1997年10月4日，星期六，下午1点刚过，退休人员罗纳德·麦克唐纳和穆里尔·麦克唐纳夫妇开车经过克利福德路。

sentences.en: The unsealed back road framed the Craigieburn Railway line on the industrial outskirts of Somerton, a suburb 21 kilometres north of Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 这条未铺设路面的小路环绕着克雷吉本铁路线，位于墨尔本以北21公里的萨默顿工业郊区。

sentences.en: The area drew little traffic and was used as an illegal dump site for hard rubbish.
sentences.zh: 该地区人迹罕至，被当作非法倾倒建筑垃圾的场所。

sentences.en: The MacDonalds often took Clifford's Road on their route home, keeping an eye out for any new junk piles to rummage through.
sentences.zh: 麦克唐纳夫妇回家时经常走克利福德路，顺便留意有没有新的垃圾堆可以翻找。

sentences.en: Sometimes they'd uncover something worth selling.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会发现一些值得变卖的东西。

sentences.en: The couple were joined that day by Muriel's sister, Elaine.
sentences.zh: 那天，穆里尔的妹妹伊莱恩也和他们在一起。

sentences.en: The trio spotted an assortment of computer parts and boxes discarded among the overgrown grass and pulled over to examine the pile.
sentences.zh: 三人发现杂草丛中丢弃着各种电脑零件和盒子，于是靠边停车查看。

sentences.en: Ronald lifted a sheet of cardboard and exclaimed,
sentences.zh: 罗纳德掀开一块纸板，惊呼道：

sentences.en: Oh, what's that?
sentences.zh: “噢，那是什么？”

sentences.en: He could see a hand and part of a leg.
sentences.zh: 他能看到一只手和一部分腿。

sentences.en: Muriel thought her husband had exposed a store mannequin.
sentences.zh: 穆里尔以为丈夫发现了一个商店模特。

sentences.en: I don't think so, Ronald replied.
sentences.zh: “我不这么认为。”罗纳德回答。

sentences.en: He observed rings on the fingers, a bracelet on the wrist and a tattoo on the leg.
sentences.zh: 他观察到手指上有戒指，手腕上有手镯，腿上还有纹身。

sentences.en: He knew it was a human body.
sentences.zh: 他知道那是一具人类遗体。

sentences.en: Ronald returned to his car where he had a phone fitted and called the police.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德回到车上，用安装在车里的电话报了警。

sentences.en: Officers arrived and identified the body as a middle-aged woman with bleached blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到现场，确认死者是一名染着金发的中年女性。

sentences.en: Her pants and underwear had been pulled down and her blouse and top were pushed up.
sentences.zh: 她的裤子和内裤被拉了下来，衬衫和上衣被推到了上面。

sentences.en: A large wound was visible on the left side of her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 她的左胸处有一处明显的巨大伤口。

sentences.en: There was also something poking out of the woman's lips.
sentences.zh: 女人的嘴里似乎还有东西露出来。

sentences.en: It was a nipple.
sentences.zh: 那是乳头。

sentences.en: Her left breast had been removed and stuffed into her mouth.
sentences.zh: 她的左侧乳房被割下并塞进了嘴里。

sentences.en: The victim was known to authorities and welfare services.
sentences.zh: 受害者是当地政府和福利机构的熟面孔。

sentences.en: She was 40-year-old Margaret Marr from the neighbouring suburb of Craigieburn.
sentences.zh: 她是来自邻近郊区克雷吉本的40岁女子玛格丽特·马尔。

sentences.en: Margaret typically lived alone, but her teenage daughter had been staying with her as they endeavoured to bridge a gap that had formed between them.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特通常独居，但她十几岁的女儿最近一直和她住在一起，试图弥合两人之间产生的隔阂。

sentences.en: Margaret had lived an ordinary life as a bank worker until she was introduced to heroin.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特曾是一名银行职员，过着平凡的生活，直到她接触了海洛因。

sentences.en: By October 1997, she was a recovering long-term drug user and sex worker.
sentences.zh: 到1997年10月，她是一名正在康复中的长期吸毒者和性工作者。

sentences.en: An autopsy concluded that Margaret had been killed elsewhere, then dumped on the side of Clifford's Road in the early hours of the day she was found.
sentences.zh: 尸检结论显示，玛格丽特是在别处遇害，然后于被发现当天的凌晨被弃置在克利福德路边。

sentences.en: She had bruising and stab wounds across her neck, abdomen and limbs and had sustained a severe blow to the upper right side of her head.
sentences.zh: 她的颈部、腹部和四肢有瘀伤和刺伤，头部右上方受到过重击。

sentences.en: Her left wrist had a particularly deep incision and her neck featured evidence of compression, though her exact cause of death couldn't be ascertained.
sentences.zh: 她的左手腕有一处特别深的切口，颈部有受压痕迹，但无法确定确切死因。

sentences.en: Margaret's left breast had been mutilated post-mortem by a knife used in a ragged, soaring motion.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特的左侧乳房是在死后被一把刀以粗糙、锯齿状的动作割下的。

sentences.en: A timeline of her final movements was pieced together.
sentences.zh: 调查人员拼凑出了她最后行踪的时间线。

sentences.en: Margaret left home at 7 on the night of Friday October 3 to visit a local news agency.
sentences.zh: 10月3日星期五晚上7点，玛格丽特离家前往当地一家报刊亭。

sentences.en: By the time she returned home, her daughter had gone out and taken the house keys with her, leaving Margaret locked out.
sentences.zh: 当她回到家时，女儿已经出门并带走了家门钥匙，导致玛格丽特被锁在门外。

sentences.en: She asked a neighbour for help, but they didn't have the tools needed to get into her house.
sentences.zh: 她向邻居求助，但对方没有进入她家所需的工具。

sentences.en: At around 7.45pm, Margaret was sighted hitchhiking on the nearby Hume Highway.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点45分左右，有人看到玛格丽特在附近的休姆高速公路上搭便车。

sentences.en: This wasn't unusual, as Margaret often relied on hitchhiking to get around.
sentences.zh: 这并不罕见，因为玛格丽特经常靠搭便车出行。

sentences.en: At 8.05pm, she was spotted entering a pharmacy in the nearby suburb of Strathmore, where she bought medication.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点05分，她被发现进入了附近斯特拉斯莫尔郊区的一家药店，购买了药物。

sentences.en: She then got herself several kilometres north to a shopping complex in Broadmeadows.
sentences.zh: 随后她又向北行进了几公里，到达了布罗德梅多斯的一个购物中心。

sentences.en: Margaret was a familiar face in the supermarket there and was seen by staff browsing the health, beauty and hygiene aisles before paying for several iteMs.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特是那家超市的常客，工作人员看到她在健康、美容和卫生用品区浏览，随后购买了几件商品。

sentences.en: At around midnight, a woman saw Margaret walking through the complex's car park carrying several shopping bags.
sentences.zh: 午夜时分，一名女子看到玛格丽特提着几个购物袋走过购物中心的停车场。

sentences.en: She wasn't seen again.
sentences.zh: 此后她便再未露面。

sentences.en: It was likely that Margaret crossed paths with her killer as she hitchhiked to each destination.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特很可能是在搭便车前往各个目的地的途中与凶手相遇的。

sentences.en: A single black woolen glove found alongside Margaret's body was thought to be the key to solving her murder.
sentences.zh: 在玛格丽特遗体旁发现的一只黑色羊毛手套，被认为是破获这起谋杀案的关键。

sentences.en: It was tested, but limitations in forensic technology prevented any significant discoveries.
sentences.zh: 手套经过了化验，但受限于当时的法医技术，未能取得重大发现。

sentences.en: A 15-minute drive south from where Margaret Ma's body was found is the expansive and serene grounds of Faulkner Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 从发现玛格丽特·马尔遗体的地方向南开车15分钟，就是广阔而宁静的福克纳公墓。

sentences.en: In the month following Margaret's murder, a woman named Janet Morton visited Faulkner Cemetery to research her family tree.
sentences.zh: 在玛格丽特遇害后的一个月里，一名叫珍妮特·莫顿的女子来到福克纳公墓研究家谱。

sentences.en: Janet stood alone in a rose garden examining plaques when she glanced up and noticed a middle-aged man on the opposite side of the flower bed.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特独自站在玫瑰园里查看铭牌，抬头时注意到花坛对面有一名中年男子。

sentences.en: He was short and overweight, with thin, light-coloured hair styled in a bowl cut.
sentences.zh: 他个子矮小，超重，留着浅色的碗盖头。

sentences.en: Janet smiled at the unassuming man, but he ignored her.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特对这名看起来不起眼的男子微笑，但他没有理会她。

sentences.en: Janet went to another section where she soon spotted the man again.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特去了另一个区域，很快又看到了那名男子。

sentences.en: She then headed to an area 50 feet away, only to realise the man had seemingly followed her there too.
sentences.zh: 随后她前往50英尺外的地方，却发现那名男子似乎也跟到了那里。

sentences.en: Janet glanced over and met his gaze, realising then that he'd been watching her.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特瞥了一眼，与他的目光对上，这才意识到他一直在盯着她看。

sentences.en: Janet moved on to an older area of the cemetery where she intended to find two particular graves.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特继续前往公墓较古老的区域，打算寻找两座特定的坟墓。

sentences.en: Her attention was casted downward as she scanned the headstones, when suddenly she heard something to her left.
sentences.zh: 她低头扫描着墓碑，突然听到左侧传来动静。

sentences.en: It was the man.
sentences.zh: 是那个男人。

sentences.en: He was moving quickly and intently towards her, with a look in his eyes Janet described as frightening.
sentences.zh: 他正快速且专注地朝她走来，眼神中透着珍妮特所描述的“令人恐惧”的神情。

sentences.en: He got so close that she instinctively put her hand up at him in a stopping motion and nervously stepped backwards.
sentences.zh: 他靠得太近了，她本能地举起手做出制止的动作，并紧张地向后退去。

sentences.en: She either screamed or yelled, but couldn't remember in the heat of the moment.
sentences.zh: 她当时尖叫还是大喊，在那种紧急情况下她已经记不清了。

sentences.en: Whatever she did, it startled the man and he walked away.
sentences.zh: 无论她做了什么，都吓到了那名男子，他随后走开了。

sentences.en: But he didn't leave.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有离开。

sentences.en: Janet spotted his feet poking out from behind a cluster of trees close by.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特看到他的脚从附近的一丛树后露了出来。

sentences.en: Overcome by fear, she turned and ran, leaping over graves until she reached her husband who was waiting in their car.
sentences.zh: 恐惧感袭来，她转身就跑，跳过一座座坟墓，直到跑到在车里等候的丈夫身边。

sentences.en: She told him about the encounter and led him to where the man was hiding.
sentences.zh: 她告诉丈夫刚才的遭遇，并带他去那名男子藏身的地方。

sentences.en: He was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 人已经不见了。

sentences.en: Janet didn't consider herself to be easily scared, but she was so troubled by the experience that she gave up on her research and refused to go back to Faulkner Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特并不认为自己是个胆小的人，但这次经历让她感到非常不安，以至于她放弃了研究，并拒绝再回福克纳公墓。

sentences.en: Janet wasn't the only one who'd encountered this man in October 1997.
sentences.zh: 1997年10月，遇到这名男子的不止珍妮特一人。

sentences.en: His behaviour revealed a prolonged campaign of harassment during which lone women in Faulkner Cemetery were watched, stalked, confronted, and chased.
sentences.zh: 他的行为揭示了一场长期的骚扰活动，期间福克纳公墓的独行女性遭到监视、跟踪、对峙和追逐。

sentences.en: Some noted his prescription glasses with thin gold frames.
sentences.zh: 一些人注意到他戴着细金框的近视眼镜。

sentences.en: He once donned blue overalls akin to those worn by tradesmen.
sentences.zh: 他曾穿过类似蓝领工人穿的蓝色工装裤。

sentences.en: No one saw him carrying a weapon, though he kept his right hand in his jacket pocket as though hiding something.
sentences.zh: 没有人看到他携带武器，但他一直把右手插在夹克口袋里，仿佛在隐藏什么。

sentences.en: The women either dismissed the man's actions as misinterpreted and likely harmless, or chose not to report him out of fear that he was indeed dangerous.
sentences.zh: 女性们要么认为这名男子的行为是被误解了，可能并无恶意，要么因为担心他确实危险而选择不举报。

sentences.en: On the morning of Saturday, November 1, Lima Berman was maintaining the Latvian Memorial section of Faulkner Cemetery when the man approached.
sentences.zh: 11月1日星期六上午，利马·伯曼正在维护福克纳公墓的拉脱维亚纪念区，这时那名男子走了过来。

sentences.en: Reeking of alcohol, he introduced himself as John Roberts.
sentences.zh: 他浑身酒气，自称是约翰·罗伯茨。

sentences.en: He kept his hands in his jacket pockets as he engaged Lima in conversation.
sentences.zh: 他双手插在夹克口袋里，与利马搭话。

sentences.en: Twice, he motioned to a nearby hedge and asked what was behind it.
sentences.zh: 他两次指向附近的树篱，问后面是什么。

sentences.en: He then pointed out a nearby grave and said it belonged to his adoptive mother.
sentences.zh: 随后他指着附近的一座坟墓说，那是他养母的墓。

sentences.en: Lima sensed something unusual about the man.
sentences.zh: 利马感觉到这个男人有些不对劲。

sentences.en: She felt like he was trying to lead her away.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他想把她引开。

sentences.en: She offered him a rake to tidy the gravesite of his adoptive mother and carried on with her work.
sentences.zh: 她递给他一把耙子，让他清理养母的墓地，然后继续忙自己的工作。

sentences.en: Later, Lima went by the grave the man had singled out.
sentences.zh: 后来，利马经过那名男子指出的坟墓。

sentences.en: It remained in a neglected state.
sentences.zh: 那里依然是一片荒芜。

sentences.en: Throughout the day, the same man was spotted multiple times.
sentences.zh: 整整一天，那名男子多次被人看到。

sentences.en: After 3pm, a woman noticed him coming towards her, but he backed off when her boyfriend approached.
sentences.zh: 下午3点后，一名女子注意到他朝自己走来，但当她的男友走近时，他退缩了。

sentences.en: Shortly before 4pm, the cemetery's mournful silence was shattered by a woman's sharp and sudden scream.
sentences.zh: 下午4点前不久，公墓哀伤的寂静被一声尖锐而突兀的女性尖叫声打破。

sentences.en: It was coming from the north, where the Greek Orthodox Memorial was located.
sentences.zh: 声音来自北部的希腊东正教纪念区。

sentences.en: A second scream rang out barely a minute later.
sentences.zh: 不到一分钟后，传来了第二声尖叫。

sentences.en: The cries decreased in pitch and volume before gradually turning into subdued moaning.
sentences.zh: 哭喊声的音调和音量逐渐降低，最后变成了压抑的呻吟。

sentences.en: The area soon fell silent again.
sentences.zh: 该区域很快又恢复了寂静。

sentences.en: At 6.45pm, Angelo Gorgewski arrived home from work to find his house unusually quiet and empty.
sentences.zh: 下午6点45分，安杰洛·戈尔格夫斯基下班回家，发现家里异常安静且空无一人。

sentences.en: His fiancée, 25-year-old Messina Halavagas, should have been there.
sentences.zh: 他的未婚妻，25岁的梅西娜·哈拉瓦加斯本应在家。

sentences.en: The couple were planning to have dinner out together and Messina was typically reliable, but hours passed with no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 两人原本计划一起出去吃晚饭，梅西娜通常很守时，但几个小时过去了，依然不见她的踪影。

sentences.en: Angelo was aware that Messina had planned to visit Faulkner Cemetery earlier that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 安杰洛知道梅西娜计划那天下午早些时候去福克纳公墓。

sentences.en: Although she didn't like cemeteries, Messina visited her grandmother's grave fortnightly to pray, lay flowers, or light a candle.
sentences.zh: 尽管她不喜欢公墓，但梅西娜每两周都会去祭拜祖母的坟墓，祈祷、献花或点燃蜡烛。

sentences.en: It was still dark at 4.30am when Angelo arrived at the cemetery to see if Messina was there.
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点30分，天还没亮，安杰洛就赶到公墓查看梅西娜是否在那里。

sentences.en: The grounds were closed, but Messina's locked car was alone in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 公墓大门紧闭，但梅西娜锁好的车独自停在停车场里。

sentences.en: Angelo called the police and escorted officers to the Greek Orthodox section where Messina's grandmother was buried.
sentences.zh: 安杰洛报了警，并带领警察前往梅西娜祖母安葬的希腊东正教区域。

sentences.en: They wandered down Roam and came across Messina Halavagas not far from her grandmother's grave, lying between two headstones.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着小路走去，在离她祖母坟墓不远处，发现了躺在两座墓碑之间的梅西娜·哈拉瓦加斯。

sentences.en: She had been stabbed to death in a frenzied attack.
sentences.zh: 她在一场疯狂的袭击中被刺身亡。

sentences.en: The ground around her was covered in blood, as were the surrounding headstones.
sentences.zh: 她周围的地面上满是鲜血，周围的墓碑上也溅满了血迹。

sentences.en: Flowers scattered across the scene indicated that Messina had been set upon unexpectedly while tending to her grandmother's grave.
sentences.zh: 散落在现场的花朵表明，梅西娜在照料祖母坟墓时遭到了突如其来的袭击。

sentences.en: A chaotic altercation ensued, with Messina's glasses and shoes coming off during the fight.
sentences.zh: 现场发生了激烈的争斗，梅西娜的眼镜和鞋子在打斗中脱落。

sentences.en: Messina's attacker pulled her upper clothing over her head.
sentences.zh: 凶手将梅西娜的上衣拉过头顶。

sentences.en: The garments remained tangled in her arms and bunched up around her chest, partially exposing her bra.
sentences.zh: 衣服缠在她的手臂上，堆在胸前，部分露出了她的胸罩。

sentences.en: Injuries to Messina's hands showed she'd fought desperately for control of the knife.
sentences.zh: 梅西娜手上的伤痕显示她曾拼命反抗，试图夺回刀具的控制权。

sentences.en: She endured 85 injuries in total, including stab wounds to her neck, abdomen, and limbs.
sentences.zh: 她总共遭受了85处伤害，包括颈部、腹部和四肢的刺伤。

sentences.en: The killer had zeroed in on Messina's chest and breasts, which featured severe wounds.
sentences.zh: 凶手集中攻击了梅西娜的胸部和乳房，造成了严重的创伤。

sentences.en: The crime was particularly disconcerting, as Messina had been killed just before 4pm in broad daylight in an inhabited public space.
sentences.zh: 这起罪行尤其令人不安，因为梅西娜是在下午4点前不久，在光天化日之下的公共场所遇害的。

sentences.en: The motive also wasn't abundantly clear.
sentences.zh: 作案动机也并不十分明确。

sentences.en: Messina Halavagas, who worked for a bank, was described as selfless and caring.
sentences.zh: 梅西娜·哈拉瓦加斯在一家银行工作，人们形容她无私且富有爱心。

sentences.en: Her family was close-knit, she had no known enemies, and she hadn't expressed concern for her safety prior to her death.
sentences.zh: 她家庭和睦，没有已知的仇人，在遇害前也从未表达过对自己安全的担忧。

sentences.en: The killer had likely been covered in blood, yet they only had to run 40 metres to reach the car park to escape without being seen.
sentences.zh: 凶手身上很可能沾满了血迹，但他只需跑40米就能到达停车场逃离，且未被任何人发现。

sentences.en: Every bush and blade of grass around the crime scene was checked, as well as the creed bed nearby.
sentences.zh: 案发现场周围的每一丛灌木和每一片草地都经过了搜查，附近的溪床也不例外。

sentences.en: All potential clues were thoroughly examined, including several cigarette butts found at the crime scene, and unique tyre tracks in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 所有潜在的线索都经过了彻底检查，包括在案发现场发现的几枚烟头，以及停车场内独特的轮胎印。

sentences.en: But it was soon realised that Messina's killer hadn't left anything behind that could lead to their identification.
sentences.zh: 但人们很快意识到，梅西娜的凶手没有留下任何能锁定其身份的线索。

sentences.en: Her heartbroken family fronted the press requesting the public's help.
sentences.zh: 她心碎的家人面对媒体，请求公众提供帮助。

sentences.en: Her father said,
sentences.zh: 她的父亲说道，

sentences.en: Visitors to the cemetery on the day of the killing came forward to report what they now believed was the sound of Messina screaming mid-attack.
sentences.zh: 案发当天去过墓地的游客站出来报告了他们当时听到的声音，他们现在认为那是梅西娜遇袭时的尖叫声。

sentences.en: As none had reported or investigated the screams, the cemetery gates were closed at 8pm, with Messina lying dead within.
sentences.zh: 由于当时无人报告或调查这些尖叫声，墓地大门在晚上8点准时关闭，而梅西娜就死在里面。

sentences.en: More reports soon came in of the frightening man who'd stalked women in the weeks leading up to Messina's death.
sentences.zh: 不久后，又有更多关于那个在梅西娜遇害前几周一直跟踪女性的可怕男子的报告传来。

sentences.en: Witnesses placed him in the cemetery on the day Messina was targeted, where he had loitered for hours.
sentences.zh: 目击者称，梅西娜遇害当天，他就在墓地里，并在那里徘徊了几个小时。

sentences.en: Police were certain he was Messina's killer, and that every other encounter was a fortunate near miss.
sentences.zh: 警方确信他就是梅西娜的凶手，而其他所有遭遇都只是侥幸逃脱。

sentences.en: This told detectives that they weren't dealing with an irrational person, but a cold and calculated killer with the presence of mind to stalk and hide.
sentences.zh: 这告诉侦探们，他们面对的不是一个非理性的人，而是一个冷静、精于算计的杀手，他有预谋地进行跟踪和隐藏。

sentences.en: A photo fit of the stalker was publicised, and a million dollar reward was offered.
sentences.zh: 警方公布了跟踪者的模拟画像，并悬赏一百万美元。

sentences.en: Six large binders were filled with information pertaining to the Halvargas case.
sentences.zh: 六个大活页夹里装满了与哈拉瓦加斯案有关的信息。

sentences.en: Detectives worked 18 hours a day, pursuing 400 leads and questioning 1,500 people.
sentences.zh: 侦探们每天工作18个小时，追踪了400条线索，询问了1500人。

sentences.en: Several suspects were interviewed, but no charges were laid.
sentences.zh: 几名嫌疑人接受了讯问，但无人被起诉。

sentences.en: Messina's mother asked herself between sobs,
sentences.zh: 梅西娜的母亲在啜泣中问自己，

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why us?
sentences.zh: 为什么是我们？

sentences.en: What did we ever do to deserve this?
sentences.zh: 我们到底做了什么要遭受这种对待？

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the investigation into the murder of Margaret Marr in Somerton had also gone cold.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对萨默顿玛格丽特·马尔谋杀案的调查也陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: A year and a half passed with no breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 一年半过去了，没有任何突破。

sentences.en: Then, at 7pm on Monday April 19, 1999,
sentences.zh: 然后，在1999年4月19日星期一晚上7点，

sentences.en: Rena Hoffman approached the weatherboard cottage rented by her good friend, Nicole Patterson.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜·霍夫曼走近了她好友妮可·帕特森租住的木板小屋。

sentences.en: 28-year-old Nicole worked from home in the suburb of Northcote, a short distance from Melbourne CBD.
sentences.zh: 28岁的妮可在家工作，住在距离墨尔本中央商务区不远的诺斯科特郊区。

sentences.en: The pair had dinner plans that night, but Rena was running late.
sentences.zh: 两人当晚有晚餐计划，但蕾娜迟到了。

sentences.en: She had left a message on Nicole's mobile to let her know, but hadn't heard anything back.
sentences.zh: 她给妮可的手机留了言告知此事，但一直没有收到回复。

sentences.en: Rena parked her car outside Nicole's home on Harper Street and made her way up the driveway, where a light illuminated the veranda.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜把车停在哈珀街妮可家门外，沿着车道走去，门廊上亮着灯。

sentences.en: Rena rang the doorbell.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜按了门铃。

sentences.en: Nicole's dog, Bella, started barking from the backyard, but Nicole didn't appear.
sentences.zh: 妮可的狗贝拉在后院叫了起来，但妮可没有出现。

sentences.en: Rena rang the doorbell several more times and waited.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜又按了几次门铃，然后等待着。

sentences.en: Growing concerned, she forced herself in.
sentences.zh: 她越来越担心，于是强行进入了屋内。

sentences.en: Nicole's home was lived in, but tidy.
sentences.zh: 妮可的家有人居住，但很整洁。

sentences.en: Lights were on throughout and music was playing from a radio in the lounge room.
sentences.zh: 屋里灯火通明，客厅的收音机里播放着音乐。

sentences.en: Rena headed towards a room at the front of the house used as Nicole's home office.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜走向房子前部的一间房，那是妮可的家庭办公室。

sentences.en: There, she found Nicole lying on the floor face up in the crucifix position.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她发现妮可面朝上躺在地板上，呈十字形。

sentences.en: She was naked from the waist down, with her underwear looped around one ankle.
sentences.zh: 她腰部以下赤裸，内衣缠绕在一只脚踝上。

sentences.en: Her cardigan was pushed up, revealing what appeared to be an orange or yellow top underneath.
sentences.zh: 她的开衫被推了上去，露出了下面看起来像是橙色或黄色的上衣。

sentences.en: The carpet around Nicole's body was soaked red, and deep gashes were visible along her wrists.
sentences.zh: 妮可尸体周围的地毯被染成了红色，手腕上有明显的深切口。

sentences.en: Rena rushed to a phone in the lounge room and called emergency services.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜冲到客厅的电话旁，拨打了紧急服务电话。

sentences.en: The operator instructed her to check if Nicole was still breathing.
sentences.zh: 接线员指示她检查妮可是否还有呼吸。

sentences.en: Nicole didn't react to Rena's voice or touch.
sentences.zh: 妮可对蕾娜的声音和触碰没有任何反应。

sentences.en: Her skin was cold and her pulse was imperceptible.
sentences.zh: 她的皮肤冰凉，脉搏也感觉不到了。

sentences.en: Rena placed her hand on Nicole's chest to see if she could feel it rising and falling.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜把手放在妮可的胸口，看能否感觉到起伏。

sentences.en: Nicole's bra was askew and Rena quickly realised she had been mistaken.
sentences.zh: 妮可的胸罩歪了，蕾娜很快意识到自己看错了。

sentences.en: Her friend wasn't wearing an orange or yellow top.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友穿的并不是橙色或黄色的上衣。

sentences.en: It was fatty tissue.
sentences.zh: 那是脂肪组织。

sentences.en: Nicole's breasts had been removed.
sentences.zh: 妮可的乳房被切除了。

sentences.en: The brutal depravity of Nicole Patterson's murder confronted the seasoned homicide detective's tasked with investigating the crime.
sentences.zh: 妮可·帕特森谋杀案的残忍程度让负责调查此案的资深凶杀案侦探感到震惊。

sentences.en: She had sustained 27 stab wounds to her back, chest, abdomen and limbs.
sentences.zh: 她的背部、胸部、腹部和四肢遭受了27处刺伤。

sentences.en: Further incisions in her thigh, wrists and hands were deemed defensive.
sentences.zh: 大腿、手腕和手部的进一步切口被认为是防御性伤口。

sentences.en: There were no signs of forced entry into Nicole's home.
sentences.zh: 妮可家没有强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: The rear door was locked, as were all the windows.
sentences.zh: 后门锁着，所有的窗户也都锁着。

sentences.en: Nicole's large dog was secured in the backyard, meaning the killer had likely entered from the front.
sentences.zh: 妮可的大狗被关在后院，这意味着凶手很可能是从前门进入的。

sentences.en: The presence of mugs and a spilled coffee pot in Nicole's office suggested that she'd engaged her killer with pleasantries before the attack.
sentences.zh: 妮可办公室里杯子和洒出的咖啡壶表明，她在遇袭前曾礼貌地接待过凶手。

sentences.en: She was struck as her back was turned.
sentences.zh: 她在转身时遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: It couldn't be ascertained with absolute certainty that Nicole had been sexually assaulted.
sentences.zh: 无法绝对确定妮可是否遭到了性侵。

sentences.en: However, what came next was deemed sexually motivated.
sentences.zh: 然而，接下来的行为被认为具有性动机。

sentences.en: Once the bulk of the attack was over, Nicole was rolled onto her back.
sentences.zh: 袭击的主要部分结束后，妮可被翻成了仰卧姿势。

sentences.en: Her top was cut away with scissors and her breasts were removed with a knife in a ragged, soaring motion.
sentences.zh: 她的上衣被剪刀剪开，乳房被刀以一种粗糙、撕裂的方式切除。

sentences.en: Nicole's killer then moved throughout her house, leaving bloodstains on a hallway wall, interior doorjamb, the front door, and inside her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 随后，妮可的凶手在屋里走动，在走廊墙壁、室内门框、前门和卧室里留下了血迹。

sentences.en: Nicole's breasts weren't found at the crime scene, indicating the killer might have taken them as a souvenir.
sentences.zh: 在案发现场没有找到妮可的乳房，这表明凶手可能将其作为战利品带走了。

sentences.en: Her purse and a driver's licence were also missing.
sentences.zh: 她的钱包和驾照也不见了。

sentences.en: Residents along Harper Street were stunned by news of the murder, recalling that Nicole was a lovely and happy young woman.
sentences.zh: 哈珀街的居民对谋杀案的消息感到震惊，他们回忆说妮可是一个可爱又快乐的年轻女性。

sentences.en: No one had witnessed anyone coming or going from Nicole's home on Monday April 19, but one neighbour had heard something strange.
sentences.zh: 没有人目击到4月19日星期一有人进出妮可家，但一位邻居听到了一些奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: They were walking past Nicole's home just after 9am when they heard a woman yell twice, You fucking can't.
sentences.zh: 他们上午9点刚过路过妮可家时，听到一个女人喊了两次：“你他妈的不行。”

sentences.en: She didn't sound angry, just upset.
sentences.zh: 她听起来并不生气，只是很心烦。

sentences.en: The passerby assumed it was a domestic argument and carried on, unwilling to pry.
sentences.zh: 路人以为那是家庭纠纷，便继续赶路，不想多管闲事。

sentences.en: Another neighbour named Bruce Thompson lived three doors down from Nicole.
sentences.zh: 另一位名叫布鲁斯·汤普森的邻居住在离妮可家三个门面的地方。

sentences.en: He was smoking on his veranda just after 9am when he heard what sounded like an injured woman's scream from the direction of Nicole's home.
sentences.zh: 上午9点刚过，他正在门廊上抽烟，听到从妮可家方向传来类似受伤女人的尖叫声。

sentences.en: Bruce looked up the street but didn't see anything untoward.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯抬头看了看街道，但没发现什么异常。

sentences.en: He stayed outside for a little longer, just in case.
sentences.zh: 为了保险起见，他在外面多待了一会儿。

sentences.en: Soon, he spotted a stocky, short-statured man walking intently with his hands in his pockets towards Westgarth Street.
sentences.zh: 很快，他看到一个身材矮壮的男人双手插在口袋里，急匆匆地朝韦斯特加斯街走去。

sentences.en: They locked eyes and Bruce gave a friendly nod, but the man carried on without responding.
sentences.zh: 他们目光交汇，布鲁斯友好地点了点头，但那人没有回应，继续往前走。

sentences.en: Bruce didn't recall seeing any blood on the man, which correlated with the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯不记得看到那人身上有血迹，这与案发现场的情况相符。

sentences.en: While Nicole's injuries were extensive, they weren't the type to cause extensive blood splatter.
sentences.zh: 虽然妮可的伤势很严重，但并不属于会导致大量喷溅血迹的类型。

sentences.en: None of her arteries had been nicked and her breasts were removed post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 她的动脉没有被割破，乳房也是在死后被切除的。

sentences.en: Any mild splatter her killer might have received could have been absorbed by his clothing, leaving little visible.
sentences.zh: 凶手身上可能沾到的少量血迹可能被衣服吸收了，几乎看不出来。

sentences.en: Detectives believed the man Bruce had witnessed was Nicole's killer, whose car was likely parked in Westgarth Street.
sentences.zh: 侦探们认为布鲁斯目击的那个男人就是妮可的凶手，他的车很可能停在韦斯特加斯街。

sentences.en: Scraps of notepaper found next to Nicole's answering machine provided a clue.
sentences.zh: 在妮可的电话答录机旁发现的纸条碎片提供了一条线索。

sentences.en: Scrawled in her handwriting at the top of one page was the name Malcolm.
sentences.zh: 其中一页纸的顶部潦草地写着“马尔科姆”这个名字。

sentences.en: The word depression was written underneath.
sentences.zh: 下面写着“抑郁”这个词。

sentences.en: Nicole was a certified psychotherapist and youth worker.
sentences.zh: 妮可是持证心理治疗师和青年工作者。

sentences.en: Described as someone always willing to help others, she had established a private practice at her home.
sentences.zh: 她被描述为一个总是乐于助人的人，并在家里开设了私人诊所。

sentences.en: In an attempt to grow her client base,
sentences.zh: 为了扩大客户群，

sentences.en: Nicole advertised her services in the Northcurt Leader newspaper.
sentences.zh: 妮可在《诺斯科特领袖报》上为自己的服务打了广告。

sentences.en: The weekend before her death,
sentences.zh: 她遇害前的那个周末，

sentences.en: Nicole spoke to her friends and family about the very first client she'd taken on, named Malcolm.
sentences.zh: 妮可向朋友和家人提到了她接手的第一个客户，名叫马尔科姆。

sentences.en: He'd seen Nicole's newspaper ad and booked a session at her home for 9am the day she was killed.
sentences.zh: 他看到了妮可的报纸广告，并预约了她遇害当天上午9点在家里进行咨询。

sentences.en: Nicole didn't elaborate out of respect for confidentiality, but she was looking forward to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 出于对保密的尊重，妮可没有透露细节，但她很期待这次会面。

sentences.en: There was evidence that the killer had cleaned up after himself by wiping down surfaces and had scoured the home for clues before fleeing.
sentences.zh: 有证据表明，凶手在逃离前曾擦拭过表面并搜寻过屋内的线索，以此清理现场。

sentences.en: Detectives knew they were dealing with an experienced offender who knew how to beat the system, yet he'd missed something very important.
sentences.zh: 侦探们知道他们面对的是一个经验丰富的罪犯，他知道如何逃避法律制裁，但他还是漏掉了一个非常重要的东西。

sentences.en: Nicole's appointment book was hidden under clothing and couch cushions in the lounge room.
sentences.zh: 妮可的预约簿被藏在客厅的衣服和沙发垫下面。

sentences.en: In it, she had noted her meeting with Malcolm and circled it.
sentences.zh: 她在上面记录了与马尔科姆的会面，并画了圈。

sentences.en: Most importantly, she had also jotted down a mobile phone number.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，她还随手记下了一个手机号码。

sentences.en: The number was traced to a 24-year-old international student named Harbogun Colley, locally known as Harry.
sentences.zh: 该号码被追踪到一名24岁的国际留学生，名叫哈博贡·科利，当地人称他为哈里。

sentences.en: He told police that he had purchased the number as part of a phone plan in mid-March 1999, a little over a month before Nicole was killed.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警方，他是1999年3月中旬购买的这个号码，作为手机套餐的一部分，距离妮可遇害仅一个多月。

sentences.en: It was just after Harry had arrived in Melbourne from India to study a Masters of Business Administration.
sentences.zh: 那时哈里刚从印度来到墨尔本攻读工商管理硕士学位。

sentences.en: Harry assured police that the phone had remained in his possession the entire time and no one else had used it.
sentences.zh: 哈里向警方保证，手机一直由他本人保管，没有其他人使用过。

sentences.en: Detectives placed Harry under covert surveillance to see if he did anything that would elevate him as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 侦探们对哈里进行了秘密监视，看他是否有任何会让他成为嫌疑人的举动。

sentences.en: All they determined was that he was a normal, law-abiding young man.
sentences.zh: 他们得出的结论是，他只是一个正常的、守法的年轻人。

sentences.en: Speaking with Harry again, detectives learned that he'd recently applied for general labour, cleaning and gardening work.
sentences.zh: 在再次与哈里交谈时，侦探们得知他最近申请了普通劳工、清洁和园艺工作。

sentences.en: He was given a contact named Peter, who told him work would commence in mid-May.
sentences.zh: 他得到一个名叫彼得的联系人，对方告诉他工作将在5月中旬开始。

sentences.en: Harry provided Peter with his mobile number so that he could be contacted closer to the start date.
sentences.zh: 哈里把自己的手机号码给了彼得，以便在临近开工日期时联系他。

sentences.en: Detectives believed Peter had contacted Nicole Patterson under the fake name Malcolm, using Harry's number as his own so that it couldn't be traced back to him.
sentences.zh: 侦探们认为彼得以马尔科姆的假名联系了妮可·帕特森，并使用哈里的号码作为自己的号码，这样就无法追查到他本人。

sentences.en: It was a clever and calculated cover-up, but flawed.
sentences.zh: 这是一个聪明且经过算计的掩盖手段，但却有漏洞。

sentences.en: Phone records from Nicole's landline revealed she had received 15 calls from a number in the lead-up to her fatal meeting.
sentences.zh: 妮可座机的通话记录显示，在致命会面之前，她曾接到过15个来自同一个号码的电话。

sentences.en: The number was associated with a landline in the suburb of Pasco Vale and registered to a man named Peter Dupas.
sentences.zh: 该号码与帕斯科谷郊区的一部座机相关联，注册人是一个名叫彼得·杜帕斯的人。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Three decades earlier, on the afternoon of Thursday, October 3, 1968,
sentences.zh: 三十年前，1968年10月3日星期四下午，

sentences.en: 15-year-old Peter Dupas left his home in the inland suburb of Mount Waverley, Victoria.
sentences.zh: 15岁的彼得·杜帕斯离开了他在维多利亚州内陆郊区芒特韦弗利的家。

sentences.en: After a short and purposeful walk, he arrived at his neighbour's house and knocked on their back door.
sentences.zh: 经过一段简短而有目的的步行，他到达了邻居家，敲了敲他们的后门。

sentences.en: Dupas was well acquainted with his neighbours and got along well with the man of the house.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯与邻居很熟，和这家的男主人相处得很好。

sentences.en: But he wasn't home that day.
sentences.zh: 但他那天不在家。

sentences.en: Only his wife,
sentences.zh: 只有他的妻子，

sentences.en: 27-year-old Anne Ackhurst, was.
sentences.zh: 27岁的安妮·阿克赫斯特在家。

sentences.en: She was nursing their five-week-old baby.
sentences.zh: 她正在给五周大的婴儿喂奶。

sentences.en: Anne opened the laundry door to Dupas, who was still wearing his uniform after a day at school.
sentences.zh: 安妮打开洗衣房的门让杜帕斯进来，他放学后还穿着校服。

sentences.en: With urgency,
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯急切地，

sentences.en: Dupas asked to borrow a sharp knife to peel some potatoes for his mother.
sentences.zh: 请求借一把锋利的刀，说是要帮他母亲削土豆。

sentences.en: After commending him for being a good son,
sentences.zh: 在称赞他是个好儿子之后，

sentences.en: Anne retrieved a small knife and handed it over.
sentences.zh: 安妮拿出一把小刀递给了他。

sentences.en: Dupas stood silently with the knife's blade pointed towards Anne.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯静静地站着，刀尖指向安妮。

sentences.en: He then launched himself towards her.
sentences.zh: 随后，他猛地扑向她。

sentences.en: Peter, what's wrong?
sentences.zh: “彼得，你怎么了？”

sentences.en: Anne asked frantically as he forced her to the ground by her hair.
sentences.zh: 安妮惊慌地问道，此时他正抓着她的头发将她按倒在地。

sentences.en: The teenager straddled Anne before wordlessly slashing at her hands, face and neck.
sentences.zh: 这个少年跨坐在安妮身上，一言不发地割向她的手、脸和脖子。

sentences.en: Wounded and bloody,
sentences.zh: 受伤且浑身是血的，

sentences.en: Anne desperately tried to grab the knife while begging to be let go.
sentences.zh: 安妮拼命想抓住刀，同时乞求他放过自己。

sentences.en: Dupas replied,
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯回答道，

sentences.en: It's too late, Anne.
sentences.zh: “太晚了，安妮。”

sentences.en: I can't stop now.
sentences.zh: “我现在停不下来了。”

sentences.en: They'll lock me up.
sentences.zh: “他们会把我关起来的。”

sentences.en: Losing strength against the determined teen,
sentences.zh: 在那个意志坚定的少年面前逐渐失去力气，

sentences.en: Anne screamed as loud as she could.
sentences.zh: 安妮尽可能大声地尖叫。

sentences.en: Peter Dupas covered Anne's mouth and nose with the palm of his free hand, then pushed his fingers down her throat to silence her.
sentences.zh: 彼得·杜帕斯用空着的那只手的手掌捂住安妮的嘴和鼻子，然后把手指伸进她的喉咙让她闭嘴。

sentences.en: Just as he began to bash Anne's head against the floor,
sentences.zh: 就在他开始把安妮的头往地板上撞时，

sentences.en: Dupas went still.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯静止了。

sentences.en: As if moving in slow motion, he looked at the knife and turned it towards himself.
sentences.zh: 仿佛慢动作一般，他看着那把刀，然后将刀尖转向了自己。

sentences.en: Anne wriggled away.
sentences.zh: 安妮挣脱开来。

sentences.en: She had sustained mostly cuts and bruises across her head and neck.
sentences.zh: 她的头部和颈部大多是割伤和淤青。

sentences.en: There were several deeper wounds to her fingers and face, which would require a couple of stitches at moSt.
sentences.zh: 她的手指和脸上有几处较深的伤口，最多只需要缝几针。

sentences.en: Anne coaxed Dupas to hand over the knife.
sentences.zh: 安妮劝说杜帕斯交出刀子。

sentences.en: She hid the weapon before returning to Dupas, who broke down in tears and begged her to call the police.
sentences.zh: 她藏起了凶器，然后回到杜帕斯身边，他崩溃大哭，恳求她报警。

sentences.en: In a subsequent police interview,
sentences.zh: 在随后的警方审讯中，

sentences.en: Dupas offered no explanation for the attack.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯对袭击事件未作任何解释。

sentences.en: He had no criminal history and was described by those who knew him as ordinary.
sentences.zh: 他没有犯罪前科，在熟人眼中他是一个普通人。

sentences.en: At home,
sentences.zh: 在家里，

sentences.en: Peter Dupas' upbringing was reportedly normal.
sentences.zh: 据报道，彼得·杜帕斯的成长过程很正常。

sentences.en: He was treated warmly and lovingly by his taxi driver father and Tupperware-selling mother.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是一名出租车司机，母亲卖特百惠，他们对他关爱有加。

sentences.en: They raised Dupas as an only child, as his two siblings were many years older.
sentences.zh: 他们把杜帕斯当作独生子抚养，因为他的两个兄弟姐妹比他大很多。

sentences.en: He was spoiled and never beaten.
sentences.zh: 他从小被宠坏了，从未挨过打。

sentences.en: School was a far more hostile and isolating environment.
sentences.zh: 学校的环境则要敌对和孤立得多。

sentences.en: While Peter Dupas was well regarded by educators for being polite and quiet, his peers found him strange and unfriendly.
sentences.zh: 虽然彼得·杜帕斯因礼貌安静而受到老师的好评，但同龄人却觉得他古怪且不友好。

sentences.en: Few took any notice of him and those that did bullied him for being short and overweight.
sentences.zh: 很少有人关注他，而那些关注他的人则因为他个子矮、体重超标而欺负他。

sentences.en: Prominent deposits of fat formed over his pectoral muscles, which, quote, had the appearance of female breasts and led to further insecurities.
sentences.zh: 他的胸肌上长有明显的脂肪堆积，引用当时的话说，“看起来像女性乳房”，这导致他更加自卑。

sentences.en: Dupas was physically weak and only got into typical schoolyard scraps, never showing signs of extreme violence.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯身体虚弱，只卷入过典型的校园打闹，从未表现出极端暴力的迹象。

sentences.en: With few friends and limited social skills,
sentences.zh: 由于朋友很少，社交能力有限，

sentences.en: Dupas' life was dominated by his parents.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯的生活被父母所主导。

sentences.en: He felt his mother was overprotective and smothering as he grappled with feelings of inadequacy brought about by his perfectionist father.
sentences.zh: 他觉得母亲过度保护且令人窒息，同时还要应对完美主义父亲带给他的无能感。

sentences.en: Following the teen's seemingly out-of-character attack on Ian Ackhurst, the courts concluded that he was, quote,
sentences.zh: 在那名少年对伊恩·阿克赫斯特看似反常的袭击之后，法院得出结论称，他当时，引用原话，

sentences.en: caught in an emotional conflict between the need to conform to the expectations of his parents and the unconscious urges to express his aggression and his developing masculinity.
sentences.zh: “陷入了一种情感冲突，即既需要满足父母的期望，又潜意识里渴望表达自己的攻击性和正在发展的男子气概。”

sentences.en: Dupas avoided serious punishment and was instead placed on probation for 18 months and ordered to undergo psychiatric treatment.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯避免了严厉的惩罚，而是被判处18个月缓刑，并被要求接受精神治疗。

sentences.en: When speaking in the immediate aftermath of the attack, he explained,
sentences.zh: 在袭击发生后的第一时间，他解释道：

sentences.en: I must have been trying to kill Anne or something.
sentences.zh: “我一定是想杀了安妮或者别的什么人。”

sentences.en: I don't know why I was trying to do this.
sentences.zh: “我不知道我为什么要这么做。”

sentences.en: As far as I am concerned, there is no reason for me to do anything to her.
sentences.zh: “就我而言，我没有任何理由对她做任何事。”

sentences.en: But I couldn't help myself.
sentences.zh: “但我无法控制自己。”

sentences.en: During psychiatric observation,
sentences.zh: 在精神观察期间，

sentences.en: Peter Dupas was considered a model young man.
sentences.zh: 彼得·杜帕斯被认为是一个模范青年。

sentences.en: He seemed caring and helpful and was released from hospital within two weeks.
sentences.zh: 他看起来既体贴又乐于助人，两周内就出院了。

sentences.en: By March 1972,
18-year-old Dupas had finished school and was working as an apprentice craftsman.
sentences.zh: 18岁的杜帕斯已经完成了学业，正在做一名工艺学徒。

sentences.en: One evening, he went to the suburb of Oakley when, at around midnight, he approached a residence and peered through a bathroom window.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他去了奥克利郊区，午夜时分，他靠近一处住宅，透过浴室窗户往里看。

sentences.en: There was a woman showering inside.
sentences.zh: 里面有个女人正在洗澡。

sentences.en: Her husband spotted Dupas peeping and a chase ensued.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫发现了正在偷窥的杜帕斯，随后展开了追逐。

sentences.en: When apprehended,
sentences.zh: 被抓获时，

sentences.en: Dupas asserted that he had only been taking a shortcut through the couple's yard to get to his car.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯声称他只是抄近路穿过这对夫妇的院子去取车。

sentences.en: He was given a $50 fine.
sentences.zh: 他被罚款50美元。

sentences.en: Almost two years later, in November 1973,
sentences.zh: 近两年后的1973年11月，

sentences.en: police arrived at the Dupas home and requested Peter Dupas accompany them back to the station.
sentences.zh: 警察来到杜帕斯家，要求彼得·杜帕斯跟他们回警局。

sentences.en: When he asked if the matter would take long, the officers informed him that they were inquiring about a rape.
sentences.zh: 当他问这件事是否需要很长时间时，警官告诉他，他们正在调查一起强奸案。

sentences.en: Dupas became flustered.
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯变得慌乱起来。

sentences.en: The officers told him,
sentences.zh: 警官告诉他：

sentences.en: If you are not involved, you have nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: “如果你没有参与，就没什么好担心的。”

sentences.en: Dupas started to cry and told his father,
sentences.zh: 杜帕斯开始哭泣，并对父亲说：

sentences.en: I don't want to go with them.
sentences.zh: “我不想跟他们走。”

sentences.en: His father asked how his son came to be a suspect in the rape.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲问儿子是怎么成为强奸案嫌疑人的。

sentences.en: Two weeks earlier, in the nearby suburb of Mitchum,
sentences.zh: 两周前，在附近的米彻姆郊区，

sentences.en: 23-year-old Caroline Barton was at home with her 18-month-old son when there was a knock at the front door.
sentences.zh: 23岁的卡罗琳·巴顿正带着18个月大的儿子在家，这时前门有人敲门。

sentences.en: It was a man Caroline didn't know.
sentences.zh: 那是一个卡罗琳不认识的男人。

sentences.en: He gestured towards a red car parked on the street with its bonnet up, saying that it had broken down.
sentences.zh: 他指着街上停着的一辆引擎盖掀开的红色汽车，说车坏了。

sentences.en: He asked if he could use Caroline's phone, then remarked that he might be able to fix it himself if she had a screwdriver.
sentences.zh: 他问能不能借用卡罗琳的电话，然后说如果她有螺丝刀，他或许能自己修好。

sentences.en: As Caroline went to retrieve one, the man entered her home.
sentences.zh: 当卡罗琳去取螺丝刀时，那男人闯进了她家。

sentences.en: He pulled out a knife and grabbed Caroline's baby to force her to comply, before binding the frightened mother with a cord and violently raping her.
sentences.zh: 他掏出一把刀，抓住卡罗琳的孩子强迫她就范，随后用绳子捆住惊恐的母亲，并残忍地强奸了她。

sentences.en: In the next fortnight, two other women reported incidents involving a man entering their home after requesting a screwdriver for his broken-down car.
sentences.zh: 接下来的两周里，又有两名女性报告了类似事件，称一名男子以车坏了需要螺丝刀为由进入她们家中。

sentences.en: In the first case, he only stole money and fled.
sentences.zh: 在第一起案件中，他只偷了钱就逃跑了。

sentences.en: He left the second woman's house abruptly when she said that her husband would be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 当第二名受害者说她丈夫很快就会回来时，他突然离开了。

sentences.en: Peter Dupas and his car were positively identified by all three women.
sentences.zh: 彼得·杜帕斯和他的车被这三名女性确认为嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The now 21-year-old faced charges for housebreaking, housebreaking with intent to commit a felony and rape.
sentences.zh: 当时21岁的他面临入室盗窃、意图犯罪的入室盗窃以及强奸罪的指控。

sentences.en: The trial judge stated,
sentences.zh: 审判法官表示：

sentences.en: This was one of the worst rapes that could be imagined.
sentences.zh: “这是可以想象到的最恶劣的强奸案之一。”

sentences.en: You invaded the sanctity of her home by a false story, relying upon her willingness to help in order to gain admission.
sentences.zh: “你编造谎言侵犯了她住宅的神圣性，利用她的乐于助人来获得进入的机会。”

sentences.en: You threatened her with a knife, you tied her up with a cord, you struck her, and worst of all, you threatened to harm her baby when she tried to resiSt.
sentences.zh: “你用刀威胁她，用绳子捆住她，殴打她，最糟糕的是，当她试图反抗时，你还威胁要伤害她的孩子。”

sentences.en: The judge reflected on Dupas's
sentences.zh: 法官回顾了杜帕斯

sentences.en: 1968 attack against neighbour Ian AckhurSt.
sentences.zh: 1968年袭击邻居伊恩·阿克赫斯特的案件。

sentences.en: A psychiatric report at the time asserted that Dupas had lost normal control when becoming overwhelmed by pent-up feelings of sexual needs and aggression.
sentences.zh: 当时的一份精神病学报告断言，杜帕斯在被压抑的性需求和攻击性冲动淹没时，失去了正常的控制能力。

sentences.en: The judge overseeing
sentences.zh: 负责审理

sentences.en: Peter Dupas's rape trial rejected this explanation for his most recent offending, saying,
sentences.zh: 彼得·杜帕斯强奸案的法官驳回了这一对他近期犯罪行为的解释，说道：

sentences.en: This was no sudden impulse because you must have left home that morning armed with a knife and provided with the cord to bind your victim.
sentences.zh: “这绝非突发冲动，因为你那天早上离开家时一定随身带着刀，并准备好了捆绑受害者的绳子。”

sentences.en: Given that Dupas had entered two other women's homes under similar pretenses, further indicated that he was driven by premeditation and not impulse.
sentences.zh: 鉴于杜帕斯以类似借口进入另外两名女性家中，进一步表明他是蓄谋已久，而非一时冲动。

sentences.en: Little could be ascertained from psychiatric examination of Dupas as he wouldn't admit any guilt.
sentences.zh: 由于杜帕斯拒不认罪，从精神病学检查中几乎无法得出结论。

sentences.en: It was believed he used denial as a coping mechanism and he was diagnosed with an undefined psychosexual problem.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他将否认作为一种应对机制，并被诊断出患有未定义的性心理问题。

sentences.en: In a letter to the prosecution, a detective wrote,
sentences.zh: 在一封写给检方的信中，一名侦探写道：

sentences.en: Peter Dupas is a very dangerous young person who will continue to offend where females are concerned and will possibly cause the death of one of his victims if he is not
sentences.zh: “彼得·杜帕斯是一个非常危险的年轻人，他会继续针对女性犯罪，如果他不被

sentences.en: straightened out.
sentences.zh: 纠正过来，很可能会导致其中一名受害者死亡。”

sentences.en: Peter Dupas was found guilty and sentenced to a cumulative six-month incarceration for each of the breaking counts, with a further nine years for Caroline's rape.
